_finding: The case archive is append-only. After the move to /var/lib/pos (deployment/CUTOVER.md), the impostor list started on an empty history would write a second, backfilled set of cases that cannot be undone. It must refuse while the old place holds a history and ours does not, and the list must never be written into the token dataset.

mutations.name: the guard never fires
mutations.expect: FAIL a case archive left behind at the old place, none at ours: the history is refused

mutations.name: an empty history directory counts as migrated
mutations.expect: FAIL ...an empty history directory at ours is still not a migrated one

mutations.name: a missing token dataset falls back to the working directory
mutations.find: if (!tokenDataset) throw new Error('tokenDataset is required: the directory of the token streams this list is built from')
mutations.expect: FAIL without a token dataset it refuses instead of reading the working directory

mutations.name: an unreadable old history counts as none
mutations.expect: FAIL an old history that cannot be read counts as one that may exist: refused
